title: Controllable Generative Recommendation via Guided Token Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2610.28642v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommendation over discrete Semantic IDs has become a powerful paradigm for item retrieval. Real-world systems, however, frequently require real-time controllability to balance accuracy against objectives such as diversity. Existing autoregressive methods generate tokens strictly from left to right. This fixed direction locks in early decisions, preventing holistic planning and making control difficult. Consequently, direct interventions often break the semantic structure, producing non-existent items. To address this, we propose ReGen, a framework that shifts from sequential decoding to parallel iterative refinement. ReGen reformulates generation as a mask-filling task, predicting all tokens simultaneously rather than one by one. translated_title: 基于引导式Token精炼的可控生成式推荐
translated_abstract: 基于离散语义ID（Semantic IDs）的生成式推荐已成为物品检索的一种强大范式。然而，现实世界中的系统经常需要实时可控性，以在准确性与多样性等目标之间取得平衡。现有的自回归方法严格地从左到右生成token，这种固定方向锁定了早期决策，无法进行整体规划，也使得控制变得困难。因此，直接干预往往会破坏语义结构，生成不存在的物品。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ReGen，一个从顺序解码转向并行迭代精炼的框架。ReGen将生成重新表述为掩码填充（mask-filling）任务，同时预测所有token而非逐个生成。这种全局视角使我们能够将控制信号直接作用于具有高层语义的token，而无需重新训练模型。为了确保解码出的候选能够映射到真实物品，我们引入了一种top-k……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ReGen将生成式推荐从自回归的顺序解码转变为基于掩码填充的并行迭代token精炼，无需重新训练即可直接对高层语义token施加控制信号，同时保证解码候选映射到真实物品。
en_tdlr: ReGen reformulates generative recommendation as parallel iterative mask-filling token refinement instead of left-to-right autoregressive decoding, enabling training-free direct control over high-level semantic tokens while ensuring decoded candidates map to real items.
